scheme_name: Chief Ministergi Shotharabasingi Tengbang (CMST): Scholarship Of Students With Disabilities
other_conditions: Applicant must be enrolled in a school/college/university/institution recognized by the Government of Manipur
Applicant must not be availing any other scholarship under a similar scheme from any source
benefits_summary: Scholarship up to ₹8,000 per year, with amounts varying by class level (₹3,000 for classes 1‑5, ₹4,000 for classes 6‑8, ₹6,000 for classes 9‑12, and ₹8,000 for graduate and above).
